evidence.claim: Between the 2010 and 2021 censuses, Greater Accra region grew from about 4 million people to nearly 5.5 million, an increase of almost 1.5 million.
evidence.checked_by: Claude (independent source check, at GilB request)

evidence.claim: In 2021 Greater Accra overtook Ashanti region to become Ghana's most populous region.
evidence.checked_by: Claude (independent source check, at GilB request)

evidence.claim: Ashanti region had held that position since 1970.
evidence.checked_by: Claude (independent source check, at GilB request)
evidence.qualification: GSS's own wording (via Graphic). Holds on the region boundaries of the time (Eastern, then including Accra, led in 1960). On today's boundaries Ashanti also led in 1960. Owner wording decision.

evidence.claim: In 2010 Ashanti was more than 770,000 people ahead; by 2021 Greater Accra was ahead by a little over 15,000.
evidence.checked_by: Claude (independent source check, at GilB request)

evidence.claim: In a later breakdown of the 2010 census, Accra Metropolitan, not counting La, had about 1.67 million residents.
evidence.checked_by: GilB (owner) on confirmation; Claude cross-check via citypopulation.de
evidence.qualification: 1,665,086 (post-2012 AMA, excluding La Dade-Kotopon 183,528). Recorded as Verified on owner confirmation (GilB, 2026-11-25); Claude did not open the GSS district table, which was offline.

evidence.claim: By 2021, the 10 districts formed from the former metropolis had a combined census population of about 1.28 million, a gap of roughly 384,000.
evidence.checked_by: GilB (owner) on confirmation; Claude cross-check via citypopulation.de
evidence.qualification: 1,281,570; 1,665,086 - 1,281,570 = 383,516. Boundary equivalence not certified (ISS-011); not proof that people left. Recorded as Verified on owner confirmation (GilB, 2026-11-25); Claude did not open the GSS district table, which was offline.

evidence.claim: Kpone Katamanso went from about 110,000 residents to more than 417,000.
evidence.checked_by: GilB (owner) on confirmation; Claude cross-check via citypopulation.de
evidence.qualification: 109,864 (2010) to 417,334 (2021). Recorded as Verified on owner confirmation (GilB, 2026-11-25); Claude did not open the GSS district table, which was offline.

evidence.claim: District boundaries changed between the censuses, and the census records where people were counted on census night, so these numbers don't prove 384,000 people left the old city or went to Kpone Katamanso.
evidence.checked_by: Claude (independent source check, at GilB request)
